response: The legacy memo is not current. Despite the statement that it is 'superseded' in the legacy-policy, the release-policy clearly outlines the current process for model releases. According to the release-policy, production model changes require an evaluation on a frozen holdout. Models are promoted only when F1 improves by at least 0.005 and ROC-AUC drops by no more than 0.01. A drift alert alone does not authorize promotion.

# Release policy — example company handbook
Production model changes require an evaluation on a frozen holdout. Promote only when F1 improves by at least 0.005 and ROC-AUC drops by no more than 0.01. A drift alert alone never authorizes promotion. Keep the previous production version for rollback. The release approver is the project owner.
